instructions.answer_policy: Include a direct answer for objective items and a model answer where the task requires sentence transformation or original sentence writing.

categories.name: Repeated Action in the Past — Would / Used to

questions.question: He is Mr. Rajesh. His car was stolen. (whose)
questions.answer: He is Mr. Rajesh whose car was stolen.

questions.question: Revathi studied in Kurnool. She is a doctor. (who)
questions.answer: Revathi, who studied in Kurnool, is a doctor.

questions.question: We booked tickets for a movie. Those were cancelled. (which)
questions.answer: The tickets which we booked for a movie were cancelled.

questions.question: She met most of the people. They were from the US. (who)

questions.question: I saw a girl. She was singing beautifully. (who)

questions.question: This is Nirosha. I was praising her. (whom)
